Chelyabinsk vs KAMAZ: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Russian Cup Regions Path Round of 16 match, where FC Chelyabinsk hosts KAMAZ from Naberezhnye Chelny. This is a confrontation between two strong teams from the First League who are neighbors in the league table and are showing good results this season.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK)
Stadium: Central Stadium, Chelyabinsk
Competition: Russian Cup, Regions Path, Round of 16

Chelyabinsk vs KAMAZ: Match Preview

Both teams approach this cup tie in excellent form. Chelyabinsk is unbeaten in twelve matches across all competitions and defeated Rodina Moscow on penalties in the previous cup round. KAMAZ, in turn, has also gained momentum, thrashing Ural (5-1) and Yenisey (5-0) in recent First League matches. In the Cup, the 'Avtozavodtsy' previously overcame Chayka (3-1). The teams occupy adjacent sixth and seventh places in the league, which promises an equal and tense battle.

Team Form and Analysis

Chelyabinsk

Roman Pilipchuk's team demonstrates a very organized and pragmatic style of football, with a particularly solid defense. Their long unbeaten streak is a testament to the good atmosphere within the team and their tactical discipline. The home-field advantage, where Chelyabinsk is traditionally strong, will be an additional asset for the hosts in this cup encounter.

KAMAZ

The team from Naberezhnye Chelny plays bright and high-scoring football. Even after the departure of head coach Ildar Akhmetzyanov to Orenburg, KAMAZ continues to showcase its attacking power under the guidance of Anton Khazov. The visitors will aim to impose their style of play and use their attacking strengths to advance to the next round.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Chelyabinsk (5-3-2): Averkiev; Burmistrov, Kamlashev, Nosov, Chistyakov, Zamyatin; Kozlov, Zyryanov, Pasevich; Mashukov, Safronov.
  • KAMAZ (4-2-3-1): Anisimov; Paltsev, Pochivalin, Ratnikov, Abramov; Talikin, Kul; Gagloev, Kirsanov, Bakaev; Fartuna.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

A tight match between two evenly matched teams is expected. Chelyabinsk has the advantage of their home ground and a more reliable defense. KAMAZ, however, possesses a powerful attack. It is likely that a single goal will decide the fate of the match.

  • Main Prediction: Chelyabinsk Double Chance (1X). The long unbeaten streak and home-field advantage make the hosts at least an equal in this pairing.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. The knockout nature of the cup match and Chelyabinsk's solid defensive play suggest a low-scoring outcome.

Lecce vs Napoli: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the Serie A Matchday 8 fixture, where Lecce hosts one of the league leaders, Napoli, at their home ground, Stadio Via del Mare. The visitors come into the match as clear favorites, holding an overwhelming advantage in head-to-head encounters.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK)
Stadium: Stadio Via del Mare, Lecce
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 8

Lecce vs Napoli: Match Preview

Napoli comes into this match looking to extend their impressive winning streak against Lecce, which currently stands at five consecutive matches. Last season, the Neapolitans thrashed the Giallorossi 4-0 on their home turf. Lecce, on the other hand, is a strong home team that will try to put up a fight and end their losing streak against the Naples side. However, statistics are against them: Lecce has lost 9 of the last 17 head-to-head encounters.

Team Form and Analysis

Lecce

Luca Gotti's side is positioned in the middle of the league table. Lecce focuses on organized defense and quick counter-attacks. At home, backed by their passionate fans, the 'Salentini' play with particular aggression and dedication. However, the team often lacks the class to compete against top clubs, as confirmed by their history against Napoli.

Napoli

One of the main Scudetto contenders is in good form and fighting for the top spots. Napoli's attacking potential is among the best in the league, thanks to players like Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Victor Osimhen. Antonio Conte's team will be aiming for another convincing victory to keep pace with their rivals in the title race.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Lecce (4-3-3): Falcone; Gendrey, Baschirotto, Pongračić, Gallo; Kaba, Ramadani, Rafia; Almqvist, Krstović, Banda.
  • Napoli (4-3-3): Meret; Di Lorenzo, Rrahmani, Natan, Olivera; Anguissa, Lobotka, Zieliński; Politano, Osimhen, Kvaratskhelia.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Napoli is the undisputed favorite. Their complete dominance in recent head-to-head meetings and the difference in class leave Lecce with little chance.

  • Main Prediction: Napoli to Win with a (-1) Handicap. The Neapolitans regularly beat Lecce with a comfortable margin.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The last two head-to-head matches at Lecce's home ground saw 3 and 4 goals scored, and Napoli's attack is capable of ensuring a high-scoring game.

Al Nassr vs Al Ittihad: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the greatest rivalry in Saudi football, the 'El Clásico' between Al Nassr and Al Ittihad, in the King Cup. This is more than just a match; it's a clash of titans, a duel between Cristiano Ronaldo and Karim Benzema, the outcome of which is of immense importance to both teams aiming to lift the trophy.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 17:00 UTC (20:00 MSK)
Stadium: Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh
Competition: Saudi King Cup

Al Nassr vs Al Ittihad: Match Preview

Al Nassr comes into this match looking to end an extremely poor run against their most bitter rival. Al Ittihad has become a bogey team for the capital club, remaining unbeaten in the last six head-to-head encounters across all competitions. However, on their home turf, with the support of their fans and with Cristiano Ronaldo in the lineup, Al Nassr is determined to seek revenge. Al Ittihad, the reigning league champions, will rely on the experience and cohesion of their star-studded squad.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Nassr

The team from Riyadh showcases phenomenal attacking power. The trio of Ronaldo, Sadio Mané, and Talisca is one of the strongest in Asia. Al Nassr dominates most of their matches, controlling possession and creating a vast number of chances. In a do-or-die cup match, the team will be highly motivated to prove their superiority and break their winless streak.

Al Ittihad

The 'Tigers' from Jeddah are known for their balanced play. An impassable midfield led by N'Golo Kanté and Fabinho ensures defensive solidity, while in attack, all hopes rest on the genius of Karim Benzema. Al Ittihad knows how to play against Al Nassr, tactically neutralizing their key players and capitalizing on their own chances on the counter-attack, as proven by their dominance in recent head-to-head meetings.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Al Nassr (4-2-3-1): Al-Aqidi; Al-Ghannam, Laporte, Al-Amri, Telles; Brozović, Al-Khaibari; Talisca, Otávio, Mané; Ronaldo.
  • Al Ittihad (4-3-3): Al-Mayouf; Al-Shanqeeti, Felipe, Hegazi, Kadesh; Kanté, Fabinho, Al-Ghamdi; Romarinho, Benzema, Jota.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This will be a battle between two evenly matched rivals, where the individual brilliance of stars and the tactical decisions of the coaches will come to the forefront. Al Nassr has the home advantage and is hungry for revenge, but Al Ittihad has proven to be an extremely difficult opponent for them.

  • Main Prediction: Both Teams to Score. In a showdown featuring such powerful attacking lines led by Ronaldo and Benzema, an exchange of goals seems almost inevitable.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Recent 'El Clásicos' have often been high-scoring, and the knockout status of the cup match will only add to the open nature of the game.

Constància vs Girona: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Copa del Rey first-round match, where the modest club CE Constància from Inca (Mallorca), playing in the fifth tier, hosts one of the La Liga leaders, Girona. This is a classic David vs. Goliath cup tie, a true festival of football for the hosts, and a serious test for the Catalan club, which is determined to compete for the trophy this season.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 18:00 UTC (21:00 MSK)
Stadium: Nou Camp d'Inca, Inca
Competition: Copa del Rey, 1st Round

Constància vs Girona: Match Preview

For Constància, currently 7th in their Tercera group, this match is a historic event. The opportunity to play at home against a La Liga-level team is a once-in-a-lifetime occasion. Girona, on the other hand, comes into the match as the overwhelming favorite. The Catalan's coach, Míchel, has stated that the team is serious about the Cup as it represents a real chance to win a trophy. It is expected that Girona's lineup will feature rotation players, including Ukrainian legionnaires Viktor Tsygankov and Vladyslav Vanat, who are in the squad for the match.

Team Form and Analysis

Constància

The club from Mallorca is semi-professional, and for its players, the match against Girona is the biggest game of their careers. The team has shown inconsistent results in their division, alternating wins and losses. In this cup match, Constància will rely on immense dedication, the strictest defensive discipline, and the support of their home crowd.

Girona

The Catalan club, despite a mixed run of form in the league with draws and losses, remains one of the top teams in Spanish football. The Copa del Rey is an important goal for the team, so even with squad rotation, Girona will field a strong and motivated side. Players who get limited game time will be eager to prove their worth.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Constància (5-4-1): Pocito; Buendía, Florit, Herreros, Mete, Hernández; González, Gálvez, Planes, Campins; Castaño.
  • Girona (4-3-3): Krapivtsov; Arnau, Juanpe, Iakobishvili, Valery; Solís, Kebe, Pablo Torre; Tsygankov, Stuani, Vanat.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the 'magic of the cup' and the potential for the favorite to be complacent, the difference in class between the teams is too vast. Girona's serious approach to the tournament leaves the hosts with virtually no chance.

  • Main Prediction: Girona to Win with a (-2.5) Handicap. The quality of the Catalan club's players, even with rotation, should ensure a comprehensive victory over their modest opponents.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. Girona's players will be eager to impress in attack, which promises a high-scoring match.

Atalanta vs Milan: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of the headline match of Italian Serie A's 8th round, as Atalanta hosts AC Milan at the Gewiss Stadium in Bergamo. This is a battle between two contenders for the Scudetto and a place in the Champions League, promising to be a true highlight of the weekend.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 19:45 UTC (22:45 MSK)
Stadium: Gewiss Stadium, Bergamo
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 8

Atalanta vs Milan: Match Preview

Atalanta comes into the match in 5th place and will be looking to end their extremely poor run against AC Milan. The Bergamo side is winless in their last six home matches against the Rossoneri. Milan, in turn, sits in 2nd place and will be eager to bounce back after a bitter 2-1 defeat to Juventus. The head-to-head history is entirely in Milan's favor, with the 'Devils' having won four of the last five matches against Atalanta in all competitions.

Team Form and Analysis

Atalanta

Gian Piero Gasperini's team traditionally showcases powerful attacking football, especially on their home turf, where they have lost only once this season. 'La Dea' (The Goddess) boasts one of the best attacks in the league, led by Gianluca Scamacca and Charles De Ketelaere. In the last round, Atalanta secured an away victory, which should boost their confidence.

Milan

The Rossoneri are in the title race and cannot afford another slip-up. The team has a star-studded squad with players like Rafael Leão, Christian Pulisic, and Theo Hernández. Despite the loss to Juve, Milan is playing quality football and will be highly motivated for the game in Bergamo. Paulo Fonseca's team will look to control possession and utilize the speed of their wingers.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Atalanta (3-4-1-2): Carnesecchi; Djimsiti, Hien, Kolašinac; Holm, de Roon, Éderson, Ruggeri; Koopmeiners; De Ketelaere, Scamacca.
  • Milan (4-3-3): Maignan; Calabria, Thiaw, Tomori, Hernández; Loftus-Cheek, Reijnders, Musah; Pulisic, Giroud, Leão.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

An exciting and high-scoring match is expected between two attacking teams. Atalanta is strong at home, but Milan has a slight edge in quality, will be hungry for redemption after their recent setback, and holds a commanding head-to-head advantage.

  • Main Prediction: AC Milan to Win. The Rossoneri have a historically successful record in Bergamo and, being motivated after a defeat, should take all three points.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both Teams to Score. Both Atalanta and Milan possess formidable attacking lines and rarely leave the pitch without scoring.

Negreira vs Real Sociedad: Live Stream & Watch Online

Join us for the live broadcast of this Copa del Rey first-round match, where Negreira, a modest club from the regional leagues of Galicia, hosts La Liga giants, Real Sociedad. This is a classic David vs. Goliath cup tie, which marks the biggest event in the history of the small host club.

Kick-off: October 28, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK)
Stadium: Estadio Jesús García Calvo, Negreira
Competition: Copa del Rey, 1st Round

Negreira vs Real Sociedad: Match Preview

For Negreira, who compete in the sixth tier of Spanish football, this match is a true celebration and a historic occasion. Real Sociedad approaches the game as the absolute favorite, and the only real question is by what margin the Basque side will win. It is expected that coach Imanol Alguacil will rest all his key players and field a lineup of reserves and youth prospects. This will be the first official meeting between the two clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

Negreira

For the semi-professional club from Galicia, the mere fact of facing a team of Real Sociedad's caliber is already a massive victory. Negreira's players will fight for every ball, driven by incredible motivation and the support of their home crowd. The team's main and only objective will be to try to concede as few goals as possible and, if they get lucky, create a miracle by scoring a consolation goal.

Real Sociedad

The Basque club is competing on multiple fronts, so the early stages of the cup are used to give game time to fringe players. Even Sociedad's second-string lineup is several classes above their opponents. Players like André Silva, Arsen Zakharyan, and Ander Barrenetxea will get a chance to shine and prove their worth to the head coach.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Negreira (5-4-1): Manuel; Juan, Pedro, Jose, Antonio, David; Carlos, Miguel, Alberto, Fran; Pablo.
  • Real Sociedad (4-3-3): Marrero; Odriozola, Elustondo, Pacheco, Tierney; Turrientes, Zakharyan, Olasagasti; Kubo, André Silva, Barrenetxea.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite all the romance of cup competitions, there is little room for suspense in this match. The difference in level between a professional top-tier club and an amateur team is colossal.

  • Main Prediction: Real Sociedad to Win with a (-3.5) Handicap. The Basque club's reserves should comfortably thrash their opponent.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 4.5 Goals. Sociedad will dominate completely and will be looking to score as many as possible, which promises a very high-scoring match.
